module: Small editor extension that adds to the global `editor` table two functions to open BeamNG's online documentation in the browser. The other editor tools use it for their help buttons.
notes: The functions are only installed in `editor` at the onEditorInitialized hook; before that editor.openHelp is nil.
Without an argument, the "index" page is opened.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called by the editor when it is initialized. Installs editor.openHelp and editor.openCodingHelp.

editor.desc: Functions added to the global `editor` table by onEditorInitialized.

contextPageName.desc: Page name without extension; "index" if nil.

openCodingHelp.desc: Opens the editor API reference in the browser: https://documentation.beamng.com/world_editor/api_reference/<page>.html.

contextPageName.desc: Page name without extension; "index" if nil.
